==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am creating an artificial creature to help make tabletop games more immersive. The creature resembles a small blue humanoid no bigger than an action figure. It has spiky hair styled to resemble an afro made of quills.

I try testing out what it is like to battle the creature. I quickly realize that the creature is significantly more hostile than I expected it to be. I try to fend it off using a needle.

I struggle to fight the creature as it has the power to use magic. In order to defeat it, I have to cut off its magic quills. The creature ultimately falls, and I decide that it isn't ready yet for consumer use.
